replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensions by finding directions (principal components) that capture the most variance. First, standardize your data, compute the covariance matrix, find eigenvalues and eigenvectors, then project your data onto the eigenvectors. The math can be intimidating, but it’s about simplifying patterns—don’t panic! Start with small datasets.
